scope: Complete local runtime parity first; no ChatGPT/tunnel/cloud binding work
extended_native_tools: document_read: optional configured remote operator host
document_edit: remote DOCX XML replacement with package preservation
image_read: original remote bytes to native image content
implementation_summary: Generic binary APIs are compiled and registered, not local prototypes. Bounded base64 chunks, full SHA256, version-bound reads and checked atomic upload commit/replay were exercised on all six hosts.

Document/image operations support controller-local and configured-host paths with fixed trusted parser code and native verified binary transfers; caller-supplied roots/helper/SSH destination/sudo fields are rejected.
PDF insert/delete creates a distinct output, preserves source bytes and returns/render-checks the resulting page tree.
Worksheet edit patches OOXML parts while preserving unselected package payloads and cell styles. Stale formula caches are invalidated; actual recalculation is not claimed.

Previous full operator archives, persistent target-owned terminals, arbitrary shell, identity-aware external PID signals and temporary sudo authority remain unchanged and were regressed with the same binary.

visual_inspection.scope: Two rendered edited PDF pages in standalone localhost canary and two from the actual installed endpoint
visual_inspection.observations: Inserted title and New Chinese text are legible without clipping; second page contains Last. Source preservation and expected page order were independently checked by tests. This is a basic fixture visual check, not general desktop publishing fidelity.

dc_handoff.scope: New sessions appeared during concurrent work; preserved rather than treating copied PIDs as migration.

physical_reboot.reason: Repeated preflight found active HeptaBao Rust compilation and Python workloads plus an active Actions runner. No business workload was interrupted.

hosted_ci.diagnosis: Rust 1.99 strict Clippy and 383 tests, process/supervisor/binary/capture/terminal suites passed. PDF render test failed because /usr/bin/pdftoppm was absent on the hosted runner.
hosted_ci.fix: Workflow now explicitly installs and verifies poppler-utils before document worker tests; no test skipped or assertion relaxed.
hosted_ci.fix_verification: New hosted run not yet completed at receipt creation; local pdftoppm ownership confirmed as poppler-utils.

goal_status.native_documents_images: local and six-host implemented/tested within explicit format bounds
goal_status.real_sudo_pam_password: passed with synthetic isolated account; real host account password not tested
goal_status.existing_dc_live_migration: not performed; new active DC sessions appeared during parallel work and were retained
goal_status.forced_failure_rollback: passed; current binary/unit/manifest restored and DC PID unchanged

remaining_boundaries: Physical cold boot/target reboot acceptance; current tests cover controller restart and simulated target boot-identity loss, not a business-host physical reboot.
Transparent transfer of arbitrary pre-existing DC pipes/buffers/application state. Start-of-turn DC had no sessions; later two live Python-backed sessions appeared and were preserved.

Complete HTML/CSS/SVG conversion, legacy XLS support and spreadsheet formula recalculation are not implemented. Merged sheets, shared/array formulas, signed/encrypted PDF edits and special file metadata cases are refused instead of silently degraded.

Arbitrary binary content transfer is lossless, not a universal metadata-preserving filesystem copier. Symlinks and special files are refused; extended attributes/ACL/special ownership replacement remains unqualified.
Finite disk capacity, power-loss guarantees, concurrent noncooperating writers and universal process-containment guarantees are not implied.
Hosted CI green after the explicit renderer-dependency fix remains to be observed separately.
ChatGPT/workspace tunnel connection remains deliberately deferred.
